_meta.source: Constants for the virtual short-circuit lab test animation scale (scLabTest.js). Failure limits come from existing screening data (cablebus_design BLOCK_MATERIALS, insulation short-circuit limit) or user inputs, not from this file.
_meta.note: Young's modulus is used only to label how much the on-screen conductor deflection is exaggerated; it does not affect pass/fail. Values are common handbook figures recalled, not read from a primary source.

Cu.note: annealed/hard-drawn copper handbook range roughly 110 to 130 GPa

Al.note: aluminium alloys handbook value about 69 GPa

stiffness_note: Stranded conductors are softer than a solid rod of the same diameter, so the true deflection is larger and the stated exaggeration factor is an upper estimate.
